reason: Not attempted on this platform, by choice of scope, not by a failure. The PoC scope rule of 2026-11-15 asks only for the Linux Legacy UI on the lowest testable system. The Linux Modern UI needs gtkmm and GTK 3.10 or later (ui/modern/linux-gtk3), which are not part of CentOS 6 (it ships GTK 2; the packages were not queried in the image); whether GTK 3 could be built there was not tried, so nothing is claimed about it.
